final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), shares AS (SELECT healtheval, record_count, CAST(record_count AS REAL) / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), above_average AS (SELECT record_count, share FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) AS average_excess_share FROM above_average
